titolo: Claude Code plugin automates GTA 6 vertical clip creation for paid campaigns
descr: The open‑source plugin watches GTA 6 streams, extracts highlighted moments and formats 9:16 clips with hooks, captions and credits for monetization.
paragrafi: Bodila51 released gtavi-claudecode, a Claude Code plugin that turns live GTA 6 streams into short vertical clips ready for posting.
The tool installs ffmpeg, yt‑dlp and faster‑whisper, then finds trending videos, live streams and the best 15‑40 second moments using chat spikes and loudness cues.
It cuts 1080×1920 clips, adds word‑by‑word captions, a hook box and optional multilingual captions, then checks each clip against campaign rules such as length, format and banned content.
Creators can join paid clipping campaigns that pay per 1,000 views, with rates shown live on Whop Content Rewards; the plugin also supports building a faceless GTA 6 page for longer‑term earnings.
All operations run on Windows, macOS or Linux with Python 3.10+, and an NVIDIA GPU speeds up transcription, though the CPU can handle a 12‑minute video in about five minutes.
perche: For AI enthusiasts, the plugin demonstrates how large‑language‑model assistants can orchestrate video processing, transcription and content curation without manual scripting.
